headline: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) Gets A Zacks Upgrade And Dividend Lift, Is It Fully Priced?
summary: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) has drawn fresh attention after a Zacks Rank upgrade to #2 and a Board decision to lift its regular quarterly cash dividend to US$0.2400 per share, effective September 2026.
